cart_has_an_owner.name: cart_has_an_owner
cart_has_an_owner.value: "cart"."cart"."account_id" is not null or "cart"."cart"."anon_id" is not null

master_product_legal_metrology.name: master_product_legal_metrology
master_product_legal_metrology.value:
"catalog"."master_product"."status" <> 'ACTIVE'
        or "catalog"."master_product"."is_prepackaged" = false
        or (
          "catalog"."master_product"."manufacturer_packer" is not null and btrim("catalog"."master_product"."manufacturer_packer") <> ''
          and "catalog"."master_product"."country_of_origin" is not null and btrim("catalog"."master_product"."country_of_origin") <> ''
          and "catalog"."master_product"."consumer_care_contact" is not null and btrim("catalog"."master_product"."consumer_care_contact") <> ''
        )

product_request_resolution_coherent.name: product_request_resolution_coherent
product_request_resolution_coherent.value:
("catalog"."product_request"."status" = 'PENDING' and "catalog"."product_request"."resolved_master_product_id" is null)
        or ("catalog"."product_request"."status" = 'REJECTED')
        or ("catalog"."product_request"."status" in ('APPROVED', 'DUPLICATE') and "catalog"."product_request"."resolved_master_product_id" is not null)

product_request_price_within_mrp.name: product_request_price_within_mrp
product_request_price_within_mrp.value:
"catalog"."product_request"."desired_mrp_paise" is null
        or "catalog"."product_request"."desired_selling_price_paise" is null
        or "catalog"."product_request"."desired_selling_price_paise" <= "catalog"."product_request"."desired_mrp_paise"

vendor_offer_expiry_after_mfg.name: vendor_offer_expiry_after_mfg
vendor_offer_expiry_after_mfg.value: "offer"."vendor_offer"."mfg_date" is null or "offer"."vendor_offer"."expiry_date" is null or "offer"."vendor_offer"."expiry_date" >= "offer"."vendor_offer"."mfg_date"

service_area_mode_is_backed.name: service_area_mode_is_backed
service_area_mode_is_backed.value:
("serviceability"."service_area"."mode" = 'POLYGON' and "serviceability"."service_area"."polygon" is not null)
          or ("serviceability"."service_area"."mode" = 'RADIUS' and "serviceability"."service_area"."radius_meters" is not null and "serviceability"."service_area"."radius_meters" > 0)

vendor_gstin_present_when_registered.name: vendor_gstin_present_when_registered
vendor_gstin_present_when_registered.value: "vendor"."vendor"."gst_registration_type" <> 'REGISTERED' or ("vendor"."vendor"."gstin" is not null and btrim("vendor"."vendor"."gstin") <> '')
